name: OpenAI API
summary: OpenAI's API lets your app call GPT models to generate text, understand images, and power AI features.

free_plan_covers.note: No free API allowance; you must add a payment method before making calls, then pay per token used.

first_paid_usd_month.note: No flat monthly plan for the API; it is pay-as-you-go per token (ChatGPT Plus is a separate consumer product).

portability.note: Proprietary API, but its request and response shape is the de facto format many other AI providers copy.

free_tier.note: No ongoing free rate-limited tier; billing must be enabled first and every call is metered.

sdk_typescript.note: Official TypeScript/JavaScript SDK is published as the "openai" npm package.

cheap_model_price.value: gpt-5-nano: $0.05 input / $0.40 output per million tokens
cheap_model_price.note: Cheapest current general-purpose text model; gpt-5-mini is next at $0.25 input / $2.00 output per million tokens.

setup.step: Create an OpenAI account and add a payment method; the API will not respond without billing enabled.
Create an API key from the dashboard.
Set the key as an environment variable.
Install the SDK with npm install openai.
Import OpenAI and call the API from a server route.

builder_notes: Keep OPENAI_API_KEY on the server; call it from server code, never from the browser.
Set explicit max token limits and handle rate-limit errors, since cost scales directly with tokens used.
Pick the smallest model (gpt-5-nano or gpt-5-mini) that meets quality needs before reaching for a bigger, pricier one.
